status: Maintained Windows ready for user playtest
behavior: Mild cases choose actual reachable round-trip walking paths within eight route cells, otherwise personal car trips; severe cases retain ambulance pickup/admission.
Separate finite outpatient reservation and severe-bed pools each derive from operating staffed/funded hospital capacity. Mild visits never reserve or occupy inpatient beds.
Actual outpatient arrival releases clinic capacity and obtains medicine; actual home arrival starts the existing one-day mild recovery course. No new remote treatment before a visit.
Medical leave interrupts work/shopping until recovery, releasing shopping stock/cash locks. Route/provider loss releases and retries outstanding care; blocked returns wait without healing.
Dispensed medicine continues through hospital service outage after return. Severe actual admission and existing two-day inpatient treatment remain.
D124 home Health remains four bars; hospitals chart actual inpatients, held beds and outpatient visits separately. Reports label the stable remote metric Home recovery.
compatibility: Writes schema70; narrow schema68/69 imports preserve the requested current city, original bytes and creation revision. Old free Remote care resets for a real visit; old mild inpatient care returns home. Earlier builds reject new70 states. No broad migration framework.

originalCity.fixtureChanges: Isolated copy adds a real operating hospital and educated staff; selects near/far mild plus severe cases. This is City837230, not the historical City607171 assertion fixture.

visualReview: Five Editor1280 and ten packaged1280/1024 views reviewed: outpatient outward wait, return, home course, separate hospital pools and recovered home. Bars/labels readable. Ordinary startup menu reviewed. Controlled city also shows unrelated utility concerns; no broad economic balance result.
